parameters.content:
## Shopify paid order → fulfilment notice
When a Shopify order is paid, verify the HMAC signature, build a pick list (SKUs, quantities, ship-to, shipping method), email it to your warehouse/3PL and post a note to Slack.

**What you need:** n8n with `NODE_FUNCTION_ALLOW_BUILTIN=crypto` • Shopify store admin • SMTP • Slack incoming webhook

**Setup**
1. Set `NODE_FUNCTION_ALLOW_BUILTIN=crypto` on your n8n instance and restart.
2. Shopify admin → **Settings → Notifications → Webhooks** → create an **Order payment** (JSON) webhook pointing at **Order paid**'s production URL.
3. Paste the signing secret + your fulfilment/from addresses + Slack URL into the settings block atop **Verify and build pick list**.
4. Add your SMTP credential to **Email fulfilment team**, activate, send a Shopify test.

No credentials are bundled — every `REPLACE_ME` must be set before activating.
Guide: pushbuild.com/guides/shopify-automation.html

### 1 · Receive & verify
Webhook receives the paid order; **Verify and build pick list** checks the HMAC signature and assembles the pick list; anything unsigned is dropped.

### 2 · Notify
Emails the pick list to fulfilment and posts the order number + line count to Slack.
